metadata.description: Validation test for the GPS Rescue LOWSATS check (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T13a): the rescue switch goes on at 20 s; satellites drop to 2 at 27 s, in FLY_HOME. After 10 s of 1 Hz checks the rescue fails with LOWSATS: the switch-started rescue does nothing (level, last throttle) for 20 s, then aborts and disarms.
